title: Segmented probe sets and adaptive gating for staged deployments
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a new deployment-quality orchestration layer that runs segmented probe sets (small, focused eval prompt groups) against canary, A/B and shadow traffic. The system will compute lightweight, streaming scorecards and apply adaptive gating rules to pause, quarantine, or automatically roll back model variants when statistically significant degradations are detected. Unlike existing monolithic golden-set checks, this work emphasizes segment-level sensitivity, per-customer weighting, and hysteresis to avoid flapping. Deliverables include probe selection tooling, a streaming aggregator service, UI/alerting integration with Console, and safe autopilot policies with human-in-loop approvals.
acceptance_criteria: Can register multiple segmented probe sets and associate them with a rollout (canary/A-B/shadow)
Streaming aggregator computes per-probe metrics (score, latency, token-usage) and emits per-segment deltas every 30s
Adaptive gating engine enforces stop/quarantine when a segment breaches configured thresholds for X consecutive windows
Rollouts UI shows per-segment scorecards, trend sparklines, and allows one-click quarantine/rollback with audit trail
Automated rollback respects rate limits and requires secondary confirmation if customer_impact=high
implementation_notes: Probe sets: extend existing eval format to include segment metadata, weight, and expected latency buckets
Aggregator: new lightweight gRPC service that consumes streaming eval events, computes EWMA deltas and simple statistical tests (t-test + bootstrap for small N)
Gating rules: support both absolute thresholds and relative deltas against baseline; add hysteresis windows to prevent flapping
Integration: Console will fetch per-rollout probe summaries via new API; alerts sent to PagerDuty channel and rollout activity log
Safety: autopilot rollback will be a two-step process by default (quarantine -> wait 5 min -> rollback) for high-impact customers; allow opt-in aggressive rollback for internal CI runs
Telemetry: add per-probe IDs to trace spans and include sample outputs for human review when available
